description: Press each key in `keys`, in order (e.g. ['Control+A', 'Delete', 'Enter']). Focuses ref/selector first when given. For editors, click the visible content area first; reserve force:true for offscreen inputs that truly accept focus. Options: force, timeoutMs, waitForFocusMs, requireEditable (checked before the first key). Returns: { ok, session_id, keys, focused }. Errors: SELECTOR_NO_MATCH / REF_NOT_FOUND (carries similar_refs), ELEMENT_NOT_VISIBLE (retryable), NO_FOCUSED_EDITABLE, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (empty keys or ref+selector both).

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

requireEditable.description: Fail with NO_FOCUSED_EDITABLE unless keys go to an editable element.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

timeoutMs.description: Actionability budget in ms (default 5000, clamped to 30000).

waitForFocusMs.description: No target: wait up to this many ms for an editable element to take focus.

name: electron_press_sequence
title: Press a sequence of keys
